# KAPDE — Curated Luxury Menswear & Architectural Silhouettes

> KAPDE is an independent luxury menswear atelier founded in Ahmedabad, India. We engineer heavyweight tailored garments with Savile Row ease, intentional volume, and classical craftsmanship.

## Brand Manifesto
- Core Silhouettes: Tailored baggy double-pleated trousers, wide raw Japanese selvedge denim, 300 GSM ringspun cotton boxy tees, virgin wool flannel overshirts, and luxury knitwear.
- Aesthetic Direction: High-contrast monochrome, editorial restraint, shadowless flat design inspired by Aimé Leon Dore, Sohne interface typography, and Financier Display editorial headings.
- Quality Philosophy: Natural dense fibers (300–480 GSM), artisanal small batches, zero fast-fashion compromises.
- Concierge Commerce: WhatsApp 1-on-1 direct concierge ordering, personalized sizing consultation, and express dispatch.

## Product Hierarchy
- Pants & Trousers: Tailored baggy double-pleat trousers, wide-wale corduroy trousers, technical nylon track pants, Bermuda shorts.
- Denim & Jeans: 14.5oz Japanese shuttle-loom raw selvedge denim, heavy canvas carpenter pants.
- Tops & Tees: 300 GSM combed ringspun cotton heavyweight boxy tees, garment-dyed pocket tees.
- Shirts & Overshirts: Camp collar virgin wool overshirts, pinpoint oxford shirts, textured knit polo cardigans, lined mechanic canvas jackets.
- Hoodies & Knitwear: Peruvian alpaca cable knit quarter zips, Fair Isle jacquard sweaters, ribbed zip turtlenecks, loopback 480 GSM French Terry hoodies.
- Co-ord Sets: French linen-blend architectural kimono jackets with matching double-pleated shorts.
